chapter: Regional bands, politics and travel abroad
title: Charles Elgar, Eddie South and Dave Peyton in Chicago
summary: Hinton and Wilson discuss Elgar's strings-using big band and Dave Peyton at the Grand Theater.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: They could read music and play classical
things. Eddie South, Charles Elgar, remember Charles Elgar?
He was one of Eddie South's teachers. And, as you said, he had a great band.

Yeah, had that large band. When I came to Chicago he'd given up the band, I think he might have been an official of the union, then. Highly regarded by the musicians; they told me they had a lot of respect for that big band he had.
He was using strings in those days, too, I believe.
And there was another guy, Dave Peyton, did you --
He was across the street at the Grand Theater, 31st and State, I believe.
